prerequisites: Base knowledge of Physics and Mathematics

learning_outcomes.text: The student will know methods for energy savings in the residential and industrial sectors.
The student will know methods for energy management.
The student will know the characteristics of an energy management system.
Students will be able to evaluate and design new interventions in the industrial sector considering technical, economic and regulatory aspects.
Students will be able to design an energy management system.
Ability to identify the most appropriate methods to analyze the industrial energy budget.
Ability to implement the measures for energy saving in the industrial and residential sectors.
Ability to describe in written form and present in a clear and concise way the process and results of performed calculations.
Being able to apply their knowledge in contexts different from those presented during the course, and deepen the topics using materials other than those proposed.

syllabus_topics: Investment analysis and economic analysis of industrial and residential investments
Financial statements and energy savings in industry and in the residential sector
The energy manager and the energy market
Industrial production systems in the liberalized energy sector

assessment_methods.method: Oral interview related to energy management systems and energy saving measures
Discussion of an elaborate carried out during laboratory activities

assessment_rules: The evaluation will be carried out by an oral interview related to energy management systems and energy saving measures. During the interview, the student will also discuss an elaborate carried out during the laboratory activities.
